title: Setup → Company: Country, Locale and Timezone are free text; "de" is refused with no hint of the expected code (#27521 row 19)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. Split from #27521 row 19 by the seat; the parent's acceptance says each row is taken as its own card or answered.

## Business reason

Who: every administrator filling Company settings. What happens: Country is a two-letter free-text box (`maxlength=2`); typing "de" is refused ("1 setting needs attention: Country") with nothing saying what is expected; Locale and Timezone are free text too, so a typo is only found later. Reach: every administrator filling Company.

## Mechanism

- `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/company.manifest.ts`: `country` is `type: 'text'` with a two-letter pattern; `locale` and `timezone` are `text`.

Measured at `main` @ `561b7642`, re-driven (stock `examples/app-showcase --seed-admin`, admin, Chromium 1440×900).

## Wanted

Pickers: a select of ISO countries, of locales and of IANA timezones, storing the code.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Company → Country, Locale and Timezone are pickers that show names and store the code.
- [ ] An existing stored code shows as its picked option.

Refs #27521
